jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

"

As a GIS Analyst with AMS, your office is wherever data meets the real world. Whether mapping utility corridors in urban centers or analyzing terrain in remote forests, you play a critical role in supporting safe and efficient utility operations. As an AMS GIS Analyst, you will transform spatial data into actionable insights that help keep the lights on and communities safe.

Some of the most important characteristics of an AMS GIS Analyst are attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to communicate complex spatial information clearly. You are accountable for advancing a culture of safety and excellence while providing quality and value to our customers and clients.

The pay range for this position is from $20.00 to $30.00 per hour, contingent upon relevant education, experience, and industry-specific certifications. This specified range is determined by the tier associated with the job posting. However, should the employee be classified under a different tier, the compensation may fall outside the stated range.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Industry competitive pay
Medical/Health/Dental/Vision/VOYA/Paid Holidays/EAP eligibility on day one of employment (Full-Time Employees)
401K, Vacation Accrual, life insurance, long-term disability eligibility first of the month after 3 months of service
Sick Time eligibility on day 90 of employment
Weekly paychecks and direct deposit
Participation in the Employee Referral Program (must meet eligibility requirements)
Boot and clothing program (company funded, if applicable)
Ongoing training and assistance with obtaining industry certifications

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Analyze and interpret spatial data to support utility vegetation management (UVM) programs and infrastructure planning
Create, maintain, and update GIS databases, maps, and dashboards
Perform spatial analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Respond to data inquiries & support field crews and arborists with reports, maps, spreadsheets, etc.
Manage specialized databases and spreadsheets, entering data and generating reports with proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Collaborate with field teams to integrate GPS-collected data into GIS systems
Generate reports and visualizations to support decision-making and regulatory compliance
Ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms and projects
Support QA/QC processes for spatial data and field-collected information
Assist in developing and maintaining automated workflows using GIS tools and scripting
Travel may be required for field data collection or coordination with field teams

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE:

1-2 years of experience working with GIS software and databases, including ESRI Suite
Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in Geography, GIS, Environmental Science, or a related field
Proficiency in GIS software (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS)
Experience with spatial data formats and coordinate systems
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently,manage multiple tasks, and show attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Basic programming/scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, SQL) is a plus
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel if needed

WHAT WOULD BE AMAZING TO HAVE:

Experience in utility or environmental GIS applications
Familiarity with GPS data collection tools and mobile GIS apps
Certification such as GISP or Esri Technical Certification
UVM Experience
Bi-Lingual (English/Spanish) a plus

Working Environment

Primarily office-based with occasional fieldwork; may involve travel to utility corridors or remote locations. Work may include exposure to various weather conditions and terrain. Reasonable accommodation, if available, may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Physical

Must be able to sit or stand for extended periods, operate a computer and related equipment, and occasionally travel to field sites. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. and walk on uneven terrain may be required for field data collection.

Arbormetrics (AMS) is a leading provider of vegetation and asset management consulting services to the utility industry. Successful professionals at AMS have come from a variety of backgrounds, including: GIS, geography, environmental science, forestry, natural resource management, and more. For more information visit our website www.arbormetrics.com

All candidates must possess a valid driver's license and have a good driving record.

jobs.description:

Are you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe?

We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Job Description

The Senior Geospatial Data & GIS Scientist provides expertise in geospatial technologies, spatial data management, cloud-based GIS solutions, and geospatial analytics. The role supports the design, implementation, integration, and optimization of geospatial data platforms and services while ensuring data quality, interoperability, governance, and compliance with relevant standards.

What Would Make You a Fit For The Role

Design, develop, and maintain geospatial solutions using GIS platforms, spatial databases, and open-source geospatial technologies.
Perform geospatial data processing, analysis, transformation, and automation using Python and spatial analytics tools.
Develop and optimize spatial databases, data models, and geospatial data integration workflows.
Implement and support cloud-based geospatial processing and analytics solutions in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
Contribute to the integration of geospatial data within data lake, lakehouse, and enterprise analytics architectures.
Ensure adherence to metadata standards, interoperability requirements, data governance principles, and open data best practices.
Assess technical feasibility, risks, dependencies, and solution options, providing recommendations to stakeholders and project teams.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts, findings, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

What would make you a fit for the role:

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience with GIS desktop, server, and open-source geospatial technologies such as ArcGIS, QGIS, PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL/OGR, or equivalent.
Strong Python programming skills for geospatial processing using libraries such as GeoPandas, Rasterio, Shapely, Fiona, PyProj, Xarray, or similar.
Experience with SQL and spatial SQL, including spatial database technologies such as PostGIS, SQL Server Spatial, or equivalent.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based geospatial processing and analytics solutions in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
Knowledge of data lake/lakehouse architectures, geospatial data integration, metadata standards (ISO 19115, DCAT/DCAT-AP, Dublin Core), and interoperability principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to data quality, reproducibility, documentation, and operational maintainability.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary environments
Understanding of SDMX, environmental indicators, or statistical-geospatial integration is considered an asset.

We are looking for a dynamic Geospatial Content Specialist
who excels at translating advanced geospatial and remote sensing technologies into compelling both client-facing and internal documentation for stakeholders. As an integral part of our team, you will take ownership of developing and leading content development from initiation to completion, including but not limited to presentation slides, brochures, documentation, proposals, and bids. In addition to content creation, you will help maintain and manage technical writeups and content management, as well as implementing AI to streamline processes and workflows in existing content management and development. You thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and are energized by the variety each day brings, skillfully managing multiple projects at once. Your background combines hands-on experience in geospatial technologies, strong industry and market insight, and proven project management skills—enabling you to craft clear, differentiated content that positions NV5 to win in a highly competitive landscape.

Work Environment

Work Location: NV5 Geospatial Offices or Remote
Domestic travel up to 10% of the time

Salary Range:
$60,000 - $95,000 per year ($28.85 - $45.67/hour). Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and location, in addition to market and business considerations.

Exercise independent judgment to coordinate and oversee client-facing documentation development activities.
Lead the coordination of marketing material (but not limited to presentation slides, brochures, documentation, proposals, and bids) from initiation to completion, managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Ensure the marketing and documentation strategy and quality meet company standards, directly impacting the likelihood of securing new business.

Utilize AI technology to develop efficiencies in writing, content development, and content management processes.

Requirements

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent customer service and organizational skills.
Experience in a technical marketing or proposal specialist role, positioning technology services and/or software products in a B2B selling environment.
Meticulous attention to detail, with ability to maintain changes and updates throughout documentation process and future work.

Bachelor’s degree
5+years of experience in a similar role or demonstrated understanding of geospatial.
A strategic thinker with the ability to work independently.
Technical writing experience and the ability to adapt to new technological trends and translate them into solutions that address client needs.
Excellent communicator with good presentation and listening skills, adept at building relationships across multiple teams.
Ability to manage and prioritize activities.
Ability to handle complex file and information management.
Experience in submitting winning bids to RFPs/RFQs.

Ability to develop consistent, branded content for client-facing and internal stakeholders.

Job Description

Our Impact Assessment Practice team are currently recruiting a graduate within our Dublin office to start between Nov 26 - Jan 27.

Impact Assessment is part of the Environment business, which comprises around 730 professionals across the UK and Republic of Ireland. Coordinating multidisciplinary environmental inputs across a wide range of infrastructure development projects, helping them to gain development consent

Coordinating the preparation of environmental assessment reports
Post-planning consent support to projects (including during project construction and operation)

Projects

AECOM are at the forefront of delivering Environmental Impact Assessments for the nationally significant infrastructure projects that are providing for our future. Key projects include sustainable energy generation and transmission and water distribution.

Here's what you'll do:

We need people with inquiring minds who can ask the questions to understand and then shape projects to achieve environmentally beneficial outcomes. We have more than 750 graduates on our programmes across the UK and Ireland from more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible difference to the environment in which we live and work.

See our digital early careers e-brochure here

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

environmental economics, environmental management, environmental planning, environmental policy, environmental science, geography, housing (sustainable, planning, regeneration and urban management), social science, sustainable development.

Manage the EHS Department staff and students employees. Strategic Leadership, Governance & Program Management (30%)

Hire, supervise, mentor, and evaluate EHS department staff.

Stay current on EHS trends, innovations, and higher education safety benchmarks, introducing modern practices and systems.
Work with Human Resources to recommend preventative safety measures and controls and investigate employee injury incidents.

Regulatory Compliance, Audits & Agency Liaison (25%)

Direct Union College’s compliance with local, state, and federal health, safety, and environmental regulations (OSHA, EPA, NYSDEC, NYSDOH, NYS Office of Fire Prevention & Control, etc.).
Monitor changing health, safety and environmental legislation, update institutional policies and practices accordingly.
Lead the strategy, administration, and instructional delivery of institutional compliance and safety training programs (e.g., OSHA, Radiation Safety).
Oversee mandatory compliance reporting and serve as the primary institutional liaison during official agency inspections and audits (NYS Cooling Tower Registries, Asbestos and lead safety reporting, and other facilities related reports).

Serve as the designated Biosafety Officer (BSO), Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and Laser Safety Officer (LSO). Maintain compliance with Union’s Radioactive Materials License conditions, and biosafety and laser safety standards, and inventory controls.
Direct safety inspections, hazard assessments, and chemical hygiene programs in Science & Engineering research and teaching laboratories.

Environmental Protection, Hazardous Materials & Bulk Storage (15%)

Oversee environmental stewardship programs, including the Petroleum Bulk Storage (PBS) program and hazardous chemical/waste management.
Direct hazmat spill response readiness, ensuring proper containment protocols, reporting, and maintenance of emergency spill equipment.
Manage electronic and universal waste recycling programs.

Manage fire safety and life safety inspection and training schedules across academic, administrative, and residential physical environments.
Serve as a campus community liaison and share relevant health and safety information.
Respond to campus EHS emergencies, serving as the technical advisor during hazardous materials incidents or severe laboratory events.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree (in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field) required.
6+ years of directly related experience in environmental health and safety leadership, preferably in higher education.
Safety certifications preferred such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Chemical Hygiene Officer (CCHO), Certified Hazardous Material Manager (CHMM), OSHA 10 or 30 hour general industry certification.
Ability to lift 30 lbs. required.
Thorough working knowledge of EPA, OSHA, NYSDEC, NYSDOL, NYSDOH, and NYS Office of Fire Prevention & Control regulations.
Strong safety consciousness, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Demonstrated capability to lead diverse teams, and ability to foster inclusive safety practices across campus.
Able to anticipate, deliver on, and exceed the expectations of students, faculty, alumni, supervisees, and fellow staff colleagues, etc.
Ability to respond to on-campus emergencies, inspect lab/workspace facilities, handle spill response equipment, and navigate campus buildings.
